definitions.short: Ashkenaz , a Japhethite, also his descendants
definitions.full: H813. Ashkenaz אַשְׁכְּנַז proper name, masculine 1. a descendant of Japhet Gen 10:3 = 1Chr 1:6 ; = 2 a northern people Jer 51:27 וְאַשְׁכְּנָ֑ז מִנִּי אֲרָרָט מַמְלְכוֺת (perhaps a people Bithynia, = Ascan(ians) + az ending of Armen. patronymics, see especially Len Or. ii. 388 f. , also Lag Ges, Abhandl. 254 f. Di Gen 10:3 ; but see Lag Armen. Stud. 143 ). אֶשְׁכָּר see II. שׁכר . אשׁל ( be firm, firmly rooted , compare Arabic be firm ).
